metadata.title: Policies and Procedures Manual – Version 3.1 (Revised for Frosting Safety)
metadata.summary: Crumbology Bakery Co.'s humorous policy guide covering hours, dress code, product testing, and emergency frosting procedures.

text:
Crumbology Bakery Co. exists to bring joy, sugar, and questionable life choices to the breakfast pastry industry. These policies ensure that every croissant, cookie, and cupcake meets our exacting standards of fluffiness and moral integrity.

1. Hours of Operation: Employees are expected to report to the kitchen by 5:00 AM, or whenever the sourdough starter begins to hiss audibly—whichever comes first. Late arrivals must appease the Head Baker with a peace offering of at least one chocolate éclair.

2. Dress Code: Proper hairnets, aprons, and optimism are mandatory. Glitter sprinkles are considered 'business casual.' Under no circumstances should employees wear dark clothing while handling powdered sugar unless they enjoy looking like they lost a snowball fight.

3. Product Testing: Quality control requires that each batch be sampled. Repeated sampling is encouraged under the 'Confidence Verification' clause, but staff must log all bites taken in the official Cupcake Ledger (Form F-12).

4. Customer Service: Every customer deserves a smile, a pastry, and zero crumbs in their change. Should a complaint arise, employees are authorized to issue one free muffin and a heartfelt apology written in icing.

5. Emergency Procedures: In the event of a frosting malfunction, remain calm and locate the nearest piping bag. Fire drills will occur monthly; eating during drills is discouraged unless the baked good is already frosted.

Closing Statement: At Crumbology, we don’t just bake pastries—we bake memories, sometimes with too much butter, but always with love (and gloves).
